item.title: Stock market outlook today, 15 Oct: Sensex, Nifty prediction - DJIA, S&P, NASDAQ, GIFT Nifty, Kospi, Nikkei, Taiwan cues
item.description: Stock market prediction for Thursday, 15 October, 2026: Gift Nifty was trading around the 22,601 level, down nearly 10 points from the Nifty futures’ previous close, indicating a negative-to-flat start for the Indian stock market indices.

item.title: Allan Gray Sees Nigeria Rally Broader Than Korea’s AI Boom
item.description: Allan Gray Ltd., which oversees $29 billion in assets, sees Nigeria’s stock rally as more broad-based than South Korea’s, offering investors a diversification play from the artificial-intelligence frenzy that has swept markets from Wall Street to Asia.

item.title: Chip Stocks Deepen Losses as Concerns Mount Over Rates, AI Debt
item.description: A rout in global technology hardware stocks extended Thursday, as Asian chipmakers followed US peers lower on worries over Federal Reserve interest rate hikes and AI funding difficulties.

item.title: Exporter Dollar Sales Bolster Malaysian Ringgit, Analysts Say
item.description: Malaysian exporters are likely increasing conversions of their foreign-currency earnings into the ringgit, which stands to boost the local exchange rate through the rest of the year, analysts say.

item.title: Sebi likely to adopt blended pricing framework to curb expiry-day volatility in derivatives
item.description: Sebi reviewed the framework through a consultation paper in September, following pushback from market participants over a liquidity squeeze during the auction.

item.title: Copper Edges Lower After World’s Biggest Mine Averts Strike
item.description: Copper slipped after BHP Group’s Escondida mine in Chile, the world’s largest, averted a strike that would have tightened supply as the industry struggles to keep pace with demand from data centers and power grids.

item.title: Bitcoin Slides as Wall Street Risk Pullback Tests Bullish Turn
item.description: Bitcoin fell as much as 2.3% toward the lower end of its recent trading range, caught in a broader retreat from risk assets even as crypto analysts have turned sharply more bullish on the token.

item.title: Dividend, stock split record date: Last chance to buy today - Hindustan Composites, Canara Robeco, HCL and Bansal Wire
item.description: Hindustan Composites and Canara Robeco AMC declared interim dividends of ₹21 and ₹2 per share, respectively, with October 16, 2026, as the record date. HCL Technologies announced a ₹12 dividend, while Bansal Wire Industries set the same date for its five-for-one stock split.

item.title: Reliance Jio IPO: Good news for RIL shareholders! Check what the reservation quota is for them
item.description: Jio Platforms will launch its IPO from October 21 to 23, 2026, at ₹1,065– ₹1,119 per share. The fresh issue of up to 27 crore shares could raise ₹30,213 crore, potentially setting a record. Eligible Reliance Industries shareholders and employees have reserved portions.

item.title: Jio Platforms IPO confirms RIL reservation quota — How will it impact Reliance share price? Experts' views
item.description: Jio Platforms IPO: The shareholder quota has been confirmed in the IPO's final prospectus, and Jio Platforms shares worth up to ₹2,500 crore have been reserved for eligible Reliance Industries shareholders

item.title: Jio Platforms IPO: Price band fixed at ₹1,065– ₹1,119 per share; minimum bid lot set at 12 shares
item.description: Jio Platforms has set its IPO price band at ₹1,065– ₹1,119 per share. At the upper end, the offering could raise about ₹30,213 crore, potentially making it India’s largest IPO. Eligible employees will receive a ₹54-per-share discount.

item.title: IDBI Bank stake sale: Will Fairfax’s entry benefit minority shareholders? What investors should know
item.description: Fairfax Financial Holdings, founded by Prem Watsa, won approval to acquire a 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank for ₹52,877 crore. The strategic partnership is expected to bring fresh capital and support lending to smaller businesses, subject to regulatory approvals.

item.title: Jio Platforms IPO to raise $3.2bn, opens 21 Oct
item.description: While the company has not cut the number of shares on offer, with the IPO still comprising of 270 million new shares, the offer is now valued at around ₹30,200 crore, or about $3.2 billion, at the upper end of the ₹1,069-1,119 price per share.

item.title: Reliance Jio IPO has good news for eligible employees! Reservation of shares worth up to ₹500 crore confirmed
item.description: Jio Platforms’ IPO will reserve up to ₹500 crore for eligible employees. The mega issue will open for subscription on Wednesday, October 21, and close on Friday, October 23, 2026. The anchor investor bidding date has been scheduled for Monday, October 19.

item.title: Sebi bars Rajesh Mehta from trading in Rajesh Exports, keeps curbs in place
item.description: In a confirmatory order, the market regulator demands full compliance with a forensic audit following allegations of a ₹15.15-trillion revenue misrepresentation between FY21 and FY25.

item.title: Jio Platforms files RHP for IPO: Issue to open on October 21; fresh issue of up to 27 crore equity shares
item.description: Jio Platforms filed its Red Herring Prospectus on October 14, 2026, for an IPO scheduled to open October 21 and close October 23. The proposed issue includes reservations of up to ₹500 crore for eligible employees and ₹2,500 crore for eligible Reliance Industries shareholders.

item.title: Crude oil prices above $100 a barrel: Why HPCL, IOCL and BPCL could face earnings pressure, experts decode
item.description: Crude prices above $100 a barrel could squeeze Indian state-run oil marketers’ margins if petrol and diesel prices remain unchanged. HPCL faces the greatest earnings pressure, followed by IOC and BPCL.&nbsp;

item.title: LTCG, STT taxation: A tweak or removal? What’s feasible? Ace investors Shankar Sharma, Rohit Srivastava say this
item.description: Experts and investors have been advocating for the removal of LTCG ever since it was reintroduced in 2018. However, at the current juncture, the government appears unwilling to make any changes to it.

item.title: Top 2 stocks to buy for short-term: Sagility, Rain Industries by Nagaraj Shetti - Check stop loss, targets
item.description: The Nifty 50, Sensex retreated on Wednesday, giving back some of Tuesday’s gains amid higher oil prices and continued foreign outflows. Market analysts said Nifty faces resistance at 22,700–22,800, with support near 22,300, and recommended Sagility and Rain Industries for two- to three-week trades.

item.title: Defence stocks to buy: HAL, Bharat Dynamics, MIDHANI are DAM Capital's top picks with up to 39% upside - check targets
item.description: DAM Capital expects defence growth to broaden beyond orders, driven by technology, local manufacturing, exports and partnerships. It names HAL, MIDHANI and BDL as preferred public-sector picks, citing opportunities in aircraft, materials and missiles.

item.title: IPO returns decoded: Premier Energies, Tata Tech among winners; what do experts say about listing gains vs issue price?
item.description: Recent IPOs show a wide gap between listing prices and returns from IPO prices. While all 10 stocks have corrected since listing, seven remain above their IPO prices. Experts say listing gains reflect short-term demand, urging investors to focus on earnings, cash flows, valuations and fundamentals.

item.title: After a 56% jump in 6 months, Anand Rathi sees 30% further upside in this realty stock - Rationale, target price
item.description: Over the last six months, the realty stock has jumped 56% compared to a 5% decline in the equity benchmark Sensex. Year-to-date, the stock is up 30%, while the Sensex has lost nearly 15%.

item.title: Pearl Global: This multibagger textile stock gets back-to-back target price upgrades—should investors buy now?
item.description: Brokerages have turned bullish on Pearl Global Industries, citing its diversified manufacturing network, spare capacity and potential operating leverage. JM Financial initiated coverage with a Buy rating and a ₹1,610 target, while other firms also raised ratings or price targets.

item.title: Suzlon Energy shares: Up 12% in four straight sessions | Experts give 3 reasons to buy — target price, stop-loss
item.description: Suzlon Energy share price has risen from ₹36.43 to ₹40.70 per share mark in the last four straight sessions

item.title: BHEL Q2 results: Defence PSU stock up 5%, hits record high as profit soars 120%; check key highlights - Should you buy?
item.description: BHEL shares hit a record high of ₹463.60 after the company reported a 120.1% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to ₹810 crore. Revenue grew 23.8%, while EBITDA rose 76.6% and margins expanded to 11%. The board also approved a ₹500 crore manufacturing investment.

item.title: PL Capital raises Nifty 50 target to 27,589; BEL, ICICI Bank, Airtel among top picks — check price targets
item.description: PL Capital’s revised Nifty 50 target is 27,589, but the brokerage cautions that inflation, deficient rainfall and global uncertainty could prolong market weakness. Its high-conviction stock list shows potential upside of up to 52.8%.

item.title: Multibagger chemical stock Himadri Speciality up 40% in last 6 months- should investors buy or hold? Experts decode
item.description: Despite a recent correction, Himadri Speciality Chemical has delivered strong multi-year returns. The company is shifting toward advanced materials and plans a 100 GWh battery materials facility.

item.title: Top stocks to buy for short term: Bajaj Broking's expert suggests Axis Bank, VBL and 3 others - Target price, stop loss
item.description: Technical analyst Pabitro Mukherjee recommends Axis Bank, Varun Beverages, Sudarshan Chemical Industries, Kajaria Ceramics and EPL, citing chart patterns and momentum indicators.&nbsp;

item.title: Despite ICICI Life’s good Q2, investors must watch these risks
item.description: ICICI Life’s Q2 growth and margins improved, but a higher base, softer Ulip growth, regulatory proposals on commissions and potential share supply could weigh on its outlook and valuation.

item.title: This small-cap stock surged 75% since IPO price but ICICI Securities sets target below CMP; what should shareholders do?
item.description: Sudeep Pharma shares have climbed nearly 75% above their IPO price, but ICICI Securities says expectations for its emerging battery materials business are already reflected in the valuation. The brokerage retained its Hold rating while raising its target price to ₹1,000.
